top_signals.title: US Stocks Climb as Pause in Iran Strikes Pushes Oil Price Lower
top_signals.summary: US stocks rallied to start the week, with oil prices sliding as the US paused strikes against Iran and a Kazakh export terminal resumed loadings, easing supply pressures.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hong Kong crypto giant HashKey merges regional exchange into one
top_signals.summary: Hong Kong’s HashKey will unify its crypto exchange branches, with users from its Hong Kong, Global, Singapore and Middle East regions using the same platform.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Commercial crude oil inventories increased by 2.0 million barrels
top_signals.summary: For the week ending July 17, 2026, commercial crude oil inventories (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) increased 2.0 million barrels to 411.7 million barrels, 6% below the previous five-year (2021–2025) average. Gasoline inventories increased 0.8 million barrels, 7% below the five-year average. Distillate inventories increased 1.4 million barrels, 10% below the five-year average. Propane/propylene inventories increased 6.3 million barrels, 34% above the five-year average. Total commercial petroleum inventories increased by 11.6 million barrels for the week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
